description: This file defines the MigrationPluginManager class for managing migration plugins in Drupal, including enforcement of source_module properties based on migration tags and source plugin definitions.

classes.name: MigrationPluginManager
classes.description: Manages migration plugins, enforcing source_module properties based on migration tags and source plugin definitions.

methods.name: getEnforcedSourceModuleTags
methods.description: Returns the migration tags that trigger source_module enforcement.

methods.name: processDefinition
methods.description: Processes a migration plugin definition, enforcing rules related to source_module based on tags and source plugin details.
